title: Freática · la ficha del ánima
description: Emilie's ánima as far as it is built (docs/animas/freatica/): its look on whoever wears it (field clothes in the water's two colours, a staff gauge down the jacket, a water level meter at the hip) and its interface (a column of water read on a staff gauge). It has no rule and no skill yet: each skill's look is in freatica-fx. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Freática worn by Gerard, and the ánima's interface: the ground green above and blue below, the commands as marks of a staff gauge

steps.eval: { const at = window.gerard.game.fighterAt('gerard'); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: at.x, y: at.y + .8, z: at.z }, 1.3); }

steps.caption: The look: a jacket the blue-green of deep water with stripes the green of the shallows, a staff gauge of white light down its left with its three marks, and the water level meter at the hip
